Plot Human Inter-Rater Reliability Ceiling vs. LLM Calibration

Source: R/autoplot.R
autoplot.llm_human_irr.Rd

Visualizes human-vs-human inter-rater reliability metrics, and when an llm_calibration benchmark was supplied to human_irr(), plots side-by-side bars comparing LLM-human agreement directly against the human inter-rater ceiling.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'llm_human_irr'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An "llm_human_irr" object returned by human_irr().

...

Unused; included for S3 consistency.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object.

Examples

set.seed(10)
z <- rnorm(50, mean = 4, sd = 1.2)
df <- tibble::tibble(
  h1 = z + rnorm(50, sd = 0.4),
  h2 = z + rnorm(50, sd = 0.45),
  llm = 0.1 + 0.9 * z + rnorm(50, sd = 0.5)
)
cal <- calibration_metrics(df, pred_col = "llm", truth_col = "h1")
irr <- human_irr(df, rater_cols = c("h1", "h2"), llm_calibration = cal)
autoplot(irr)
